name: Otowa Yui
source:
A student at the school where Mizuki works. A bright and sociable girl. She admires Mizuki very much. Her dream is to become a wonderful teacher like Mizuki. Akira Kagami, who she was in love with, confessed to her and they began dating. She didn't even know that she was being deceived...

[Translated from [url=http://www.ail-soft.com/pro_mesunie_cha_2.htm]the official site[/url]]
